test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How often are the National Games of India held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Every 2 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Games of India** are organized every **2 years**, although the schedule may occasionally vary due to logistical, administrative, or unforeseen challenges.
 
• The event is conducted under the supervision of the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**, which is responsible for organizing and managing the games.
 
• The National Games serve as a platform to promote sports at the grassroots level and provide an opportunity for athletes from different states and union territories to compete at a national level.
 
• The games include a wide range of sports, such as **athletics, swimming, hockey, football, shooting, wrestling, and cycling**, among others.
 
• The National Games are designed to prepare athletes for international events like the **Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, and the Olympics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of the National Games:**

 
 
• The National Games were first held as the **Indian Olympic Games** in **1924** in Lahore (now in Pakistan).
 
• The name was later changed to the National Games of India in **1940**.
 
 
 
• **Structure of the National Games:**
 
 
• The National Games feature participants from all **28 states**, **8 union territories**, and organizations like the **Services Sports Control Board**.
 
• Each state/union territory fields its own contingent of athletes, who compete for medals in various disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Notable Facts:**
 
 
• The **36th National Games** were held in Gujarat in **2022**, delayed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Kerala, Maharashtra, and Punjab are some of the states that have historically performed well in the National Games.
 
 
 
• **Purpose of the National Games:**
 
 
• The National Games aim to identify and nurture sporting talent from across the country.
 
• They also promote unity and integration by bringing together athletes from diverse cultural and regional backgrounds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **National Games** are distinct from the **Khelo India Games**, which focus on school- and university-level athletes.
 
• Each edition of the National Games is hosted by a different state, which is responsible for building and upgrading infrastructure to host the event.
 
• Winning athletes in the National Games often go on to represent India in international competitions.
 
• The National Games promote the Government of India's agenda of encouraging sports as a career and fostering a culture of fitness.
